start_here: Say to your AI: "Show my welcome page." It runs tool:read-the-welcome-page and shows the words a buyer sees after checkout.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it reads the welcome page and welcome states tables of the pursuit database you name and changes nothing.
instructions: 1. Name the pursuit database that holds the rows, such as example_for_who_uses_it; the computer opens it with the read login its vault holds.
2. Say what you want in plain words; your AI calls tools:run with tool tool:read-the-welcome-page and the input.
3. Read the answer: the page title and, for each checkout state, its heading, body and actions. Show it with the screen the tool names.

worked_examples.title: Read the welcome page
worked_examples.given: The database holds the rows the read names (made-up values).
